D-Bus is the stupidest thing in the world.

Computer architects have eliminated tri-state buses from computers, so what do my fellow dumbass programmers do? They introduce the software equivalent of tri-state buses.

It is unbelievable.

Everybody does everything wrong.

Another example: I have actually proven that NixOS is a complete botch, by showing that everything they say is impossible in NixOS is easily made possible. This proves the devs have no idea what they are doing.
